interpretation_guard: Cover-plan combinatorics only. Survival points count minimum cover plans containing at least one banned root; they are not search costs and imply nothing about WIN/REFUTED verdicts of the banned roots. REFUTED-D10 and STERILE are not LOSS proofs.

structure.ie_mechanism: kill(k) = sum m - sum j2 + sum j3 - sum j4 + sum j5 for k <= 26; kill_A(k) = sum a - sum j2_A + sum j3_A - sum j4_A (j5_A == 0); kill_B(k) = sum b - sum j2_B + sum j3_B - sum j4_B + sum j5_B; j4_A comes from the 233 disjoint quads (first appearance), j5_B from the 1,872 b_only quints
